selection: Every priority_early_industry bucket with lysosomal/metabolic family or structured DMD/GNE/DM1/Friedreich disease match; SMA/ALS excluded. Six explicit supplemental discovery repairs for mixed-phase/condition-screen/academic-origin programs. Not the complete worldwide drug-development denominator.
limitations: Canonicalized finite discovery frame, not a census of all clinical entrants.
First-human dates remain mostly study-start proxies and cannot be used as independently validated clinical inception.
US approval endpoint kept separate from non-US approvals.
Explicit sponsor program stops retained separately from irreversible lifetime failures; unknown is not failure.
Current pipeline/trial activity cannot by itself identify eventual approval probability; recent entrants are right-censored.
CNS and genetic-medicine flags operationally distinct; recombinant enzyme manufacture is not gene therapy.
Untargeted outcome rows are explicitly distinguishable from researched-but-unresolved rows.
